card.name: Inside rare names and long words
card.fires_on: Fragments in the middle of rare or foreign words, such as names, place names and old-fashioned or technical words, right after a first syllable or two. Examples are D|ew, Co|ix, Seg|ed|unum, dec|uss|ating.

modes.label: Rare proper names
modes.description: Middle piece of an uncommon personal, place or foreign-language name.

modes.label: Long literary or technical words
modes.description: Middle piece of an uncommon English or Latinate word split into parts.
